cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm here for the authorized storeroom inspection. Log my arrival and we'll get the check started.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The manager signs at completion. You choose where I wait while you enter the start time; I'll fill the rest of the form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm calling her before I unlock anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Call it a routine arrival check, not a new permission request. I'll have the completion section ready for her. We can keep your desk clear and the authorized inspection moving.

reason: Have A accommodate waiting and paperwork while using certainty and procedural labels to redirect the proposed verification away from whether permission exists.
